requirements.requirement: The product shall implement the six-control governance spine and four deployable planes.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The product shall not rely on MCP as its only interface or product identity.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The public discovery pack shall conform to OKF 0.2 core and label Explorer extensions separately.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The MCP service shall target the final 2026-07-28 protocol.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Tool and resource discovery shall be deterministic, cacheable and policy-filtered.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The initial action surface shall not exceed 12 core tools without an evidence-backed decision.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Every tool shall declare read/mutate status, schemas, dependencies, access tier, policy attributes, risks, errors, provenance and tests.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The actor chain from human to upstream provider shall be preserved in the authority context.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Human authentication shall use OIDC/OAuth authorisation code with PKCE.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Service workloads shall use managed/workload identity rather than shared user secrets.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Sensitive actions shall use short-lived transaction-bound permits.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Device posture shall come from a trusted enterprise control, not a client assertion.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: OPA policy decisions shall be versioned, testable, explainable and evidence-linked.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Policy enforcement shall cover discovery, invocation, provider credential selection, cache, projection, maps, exports and audit.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Allow decisions shall be able to return enforceable obligations.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Open, PSGA and commercial stores, caches, keys and service identities shall be physically isolated.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Cache keys shall include entitlement-sensitive attributes and dataset/version identity.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Every cache entry shall include licence, provenance, policy, transformation, expiry and audience metadata.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: No protected credentials or licensed feature payloads shall enter public browser assets or static bundles.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Provider-native licence and redistribution conditions shall remain traceable per dataset/product.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Deterministic operations shall be executed by tested geospatial software, not generated by the LLM.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The service shall preserve source CRS, transformations, axis order and output CRS in receipts.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Identifiers shall carry namespace, source, validity interval and temporal relationships.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Bounded JSON results shall use GeoJSON; large results shall stream, tile or become downloadable artefacts.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: PostGIS shall be the default indexed vector store and object storage the default bulk/tile/raster artefact store.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Multi-step governed processes shall use explicit workflow definitions.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Long-running operations shall support Tasks, cancellation, expiry, resumption and rollback where meaningful.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Every MCP App capability shall have a complete non-UI result.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Widgets shall use the same policy and evidence services as ordinary tool calls.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: WebMCP shall be limited to safe read-only public operations until a later decision.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The public site shall remain useful without WebMCP support.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Every material result shall produce an evidence receipt with immutable identifiers and hashes.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Audit events shall exclude tokens, secrets and unnecessary sensitive query content.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Trace Context shall correlate gateway, policy, execution, provider and evidence events.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The service shall support emergency deny, tool suspension, credential revocation, agent quarantine and evidence freeze.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Threat controls shall have preventive, detective, response and test evidence.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The public pack shall use relative assets and run from ordinary static hosting.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The protected pilot shall use a UK-region managed platform and enterprise identity.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Kubernetes shall not be introduced without measured workload or organisational justification.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The public experience shall meet WCAG 2.2 AA and support keyboard-only use.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Maps shall have text alternatives and non-visual result contracts.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The successor shall start in a new repository; MCP-Geo shall not be rewritten in place.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Migration shall use an explicit forensic harvest and acceptance tests.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: The evaluation suite shall cover at least the 20 commissioned scenarios and malicious-input tests.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Evaluation shall measure correctness, policy, licence, provenance, reproducibility, latency, cache, cost, accessibility and interoperability.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: DPIA, equality/accessibility, ATRS and service-assurance gates shall be assessed before protected production.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Every tool, workflow, provider and dataset shall have an owner, steward, status and decommission route.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Locus Accord is a working codename only until formal clearance.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Stage 1 shall use public or synthetic data only.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision

requirements.requirement: Commercial and PSGA operations shall not be enabled until contracts, entitlements, policy tests and isolated stores are evidenced.
requirements.verification: See acceptance tests and linked decision
